analysis:
The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: it adds a 17-line paragraph at head lines 595-611 describing a four-row Gated DeltaNet prefill kernel (`GatedDeltaPrefill`) for qwen3_5, qwen3_5_moe and prism_hadamard_qwen35. The supplied units (base lines 1638-2205) are unchanged surrounding text from later in the file, so the changed paragraph itself was not visible as numbered text. I assessed it only from the patch excerpt. No code, config defaults, wire protocol, attestation, authorization, key handling or cache-storage behavior changes in this diff.

Security-relevant claims in the added text: (1) the kernel is selected per process by a probe that must match `gated_delta_step` bit for bit, else the stock kernel runs; (2) decode, MTP verification, masked updates and short windows use the stock kernel; (3) the recurrent-state bit-equality is what the prefix-cache checkpoint capture relies on (T-041 SSD tier); (4) a new env knob `DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED` can force a kernel for A/B measurement.

Residual integration questions, not findings because no code is supplied: the actual kernel implementation in GatedDelta.swift and the probe's correctness are unreviewed. If the probe were wrong, recurrent state in cached prefixes could diverge, an integrity or correctness concern touching T-041 and T-056 but not confidentiality. A forcing env var is local-operator-controlled, within the already-adversarial operator model (ADV-001/TB-003). The probe-based per-process kernel choice could slightly shift TTFT, which is relevant to the accepted SEC-035 timing oracle, but the change is narrow and the accepted risk is unchanged in kind. The remaining unchanged lines in the units are pre-existing documentation and were not re-evaluated.
